title: [A2 • Band 4.0] Bài 202: Doggerland: The Submerged Heart of Europe
passageHtml:
PASSAGE 202 (LEVEL A2 • BAND 4.0)

Doggerland: The Submerged Heart of Europe

Paragraph 1. For hundreds of years, fishermen on the North Sea often pulled up strange things inside their heavy fishing nets. Along with fish, they found the hard bones of mammoths, large deer, and old hunting tools made from antler (hard horn). For a long time, experts thought big ice floods had pushed these old items into the sea. However, new sea-floor studies proved something amazing. About 8,200 years ago, this underwater area was dry, green land. It connected Britain directly to the Netherlands, Germany, and Denmark.

Paragraph 2. Scientists call this lost land Doggerland. Around 18,000 years ago, huge ice sheets melted and filled the area with rivers, wet marshes, lakes, and thick oak forests. Stone Age hunters lived very well in this rich place. They had plenty of seasonal food, such as wild birds, river fish, shellfish, and large animals. Workers found wooden boat paddles and stone tools on the sea floor. These discoveries show that early people here knew how to travel and hunt on water.

Paragraph 3. Over thousands of years, ocean water slowly climbed higher and covered the low marshes. Then, about 8,150 years ago, a sudden disaster struck. A massive amount of mud slid down under the sea near Norway. This underwater slide created a giant tsunami with waves twenty metres high. The wall of water smashed into Doggerland's villages and ruined their clean drinking water with sea salt. Soon after, the rest of the low land sank, turning Britain into an island.

Paragraph 4. Finding old villages thirty metres under rough sea water is very difficult. Normal digging tools do not work deep underwater. To solve this problem, scientist Dr. Vincent Gaffney used special underground maps made earlier by oil and gas companies. By studying this data with computers, his team drew clear digital maps of Doggerland's hidden rivers, lakes, and hills.

groups.instructions: Do the following statements agree with the information in the passage? Write TRUE, FALSE, or NOT GIVEN.

q5.text: Fishermen in the North Sea only ever caught ordinary fish in their nets.

steps: Đoạn 1: Ngoài cá, ngư dân còn kéo lên xương voi ma mút, hươu và dụng cụ săn bắt.

q6.text: Stone Age people in Doggerland had plenty of food to eat.

steps: Đoạn 2: "They had plenty of seasonal food, such as wild birds, river fish..."

q7.text: An underwater landslide near Norway created a wave twenty metres high.

steps: Đoạn 3: Vụ trượt đất dưới biển gần Na Uy tạo ra sóng thần cao 20 mét.

q8.text: Deep-sea divers from Dr. Gaffney's team collected wooden boats from every village.

steps: Đoạn 4: Chỉ nói nhóm Gaffney vẽ bản đồ kỹ thuật số từ dữ liệu dầu khí, không nhắc tới việc thợ lặn lấy thuyền gỗ.
